children: As far as Computacenter is concerned,
consensus expectations are for first-half adjusted operating profit of £156.8m, adjusted pretax profit of £156m and revenue of £5.72bn. The gross margin is forecast at 11.4%.
On the macro front, Chinese trade figures for August and German trade data for July will be out.
said the Chinese trade data "will likely show continued strong export performance but also high import growth, not least as components for the AI data centre buildout have lifted imports this year".
